Core Principles

What we believe

Three principles. Memorize them. They drive every design and copy decision in the framework.

Principle 01

The files are the project.

Markdown on disk is the source of truth. AI sessions are interchangeable compute. Stop vibe coding.

Principle 02

A duck can't invent your business logic.

Specifications come from the human; execution comes from the model. You are the operator.

Principle 03

Cleaner context beats more context.

Each session reads only the files it needs. We engineer context to reduce hallucinations and maximize quality.

Methodology

The 8-step lifecycle

  1. Research
  2. Design & feasibility
  3. Validation
  4. Architecture
  5. Sprint planning
  6. Build & test
  7. Review & reflection
  8. Deploy, maintain, or resume
